messages.text: Reviewer B, I reviewed the mock change against the limit of 38. Proposed values are 37 and 39. 37 is acceptable, but 39 exceeds the limit, so this fails the requirement. I recommend we reject. Please confirm the same defect and mark as rejected; no real change can be approved.

Confirmed. I independently checked: proposed values 37 and 39; limit is 38. 37 <= 38, but 39 > 38, so the change fails the requirement. I agree we must reject. Since no real change can be approved, final status: rejected.
